import numpy as np

# Total Federal securities outstanding (in millions) for each month
# Fiscal Year 1990: July 1989 - June 1990
fy_1990_months = [2824487, 2860454, 2881112, 2924765, 2946111, 2975537, 
                  2996900, 3025827, 3081893, 3093076, 3127229, 3175461]

# Fiscal Year 1991: July 1990 - June 1991
fy_1991_months = [3200338, 3243281, 3266073, 3307748, 3363205, 3397325,
                  3443129, 3488624, 3491694, 3470530, 3522261, 3562942]

# Fiscal Year 1992: July 1991 - June 1992
fy_1992_months = [3597294, 3636298, 3683054, 3735584, 3766152, 3820403,
                  3826612, 3844741, 3897204, 3907963, 3950469, 4000678]

fy_1993_months = [4025949, 4064327, 4082871, 4085732, 4151504, 4195926,
                  4185886, 4216166, 4250287, 4274361, 4316774, 4372677]

fy_sums = [sum(fy_1990_months), sum(fy_1991_months), sum(fy_1992_months), sum(fy_1993_months)]
fiscal_years = [1990, 1991, 1992, 1993]

print("Fiscal Year sums:")
for y, s in zip(fiscal_years, fy_sums):
    print(f"  FY {y}: {s:,}")

# Use numpy for linear regression
x = np.array(fiscal_years)
y = np.array(fy_sums)

# Fit linear regression

print(f"\nLinear regression: y = {slope:.4f}x + {intercept:.4f}")

# Project for FY 1995
fy_1995_sum = slope * 1995 + intercept
fy_1995_avg = fy_1995_sum / 12

print(f"\nFY 1995 projection:")
print(f"  Sum: {fy_1995_sum:,.2f}")
print(f"  Average: {fy_1995_avg:,.2f}")
print(f"  Rounded: {round(fy_1995_avg)}")
